payout_quote: You will receive $40 off your qualifying first order if it is at least $100. Offer Ends 2/1/2027.
steps: Apply and be approved for the Wayfair Credit Card or Wayfair Mastercard (issued by Citi; pre-qualify with no credit-score impact)
Make your first Wayfair order of at least $100 with the new card
$40 comes off the qualifying order at checkout
catches: Wayfair-only savings, not cash; requires a $100+ first order (planned furniture/home spending, not new money)
Cannot be combined with other discounts or financing offers; excludes Perigold, outlet stores, gift cards, select manufacturers, Wayfair Professional
Credit approval required; application triggers a hard inquiry
Never spend extra just to chase the bonus - never buy furniture just to get the discount
Annual-fee net math: no annual fee on the card, so the $40 is net of fees - as long as you pay in full
Balance-carrying/APR risk: high variable purchase APR wipes the $40 savings if a balance is carried - pay the statement balance in full
biggest_catch: A $40 discount on a $100+ furniture order you were already placing - savings, not income; never buy furniture just to get it.
eligibility: Approved Wayfair Credit Card / Wayfair Mastercard holder; first order $100+
timing: $40 off at checkout on the qualifying first order; offer ends 2/1/2027.
